messages:
Lena: Heads-up 1pm visitors from Nimbus Co. Two people for a quick demo. Do we need pre-registered badges?
Reception: Pre-reg is easiest. Send full names + company to reception@redwood.com and we'll have temp badges ready. Walk-ins ok but expect a short check.
Marco: Can we also block 2 seats in the east bench near the projector? Desk app doesn't show guest bookings.
People Ops: We can reserve those seats once we have names. Also note: guest Wi-Fi is Guest-Redwood (24h). If they need temporary Okta access include emails for a 48h guest.
Lena: One of them wants to ship a demo board ahead of time. Shipping label?
Reception: Please address to: "Redwood Inference - Front Desk
Attn: Lena (Nimbus demo)
[Office street address]". For heavy items (>20lb) mark "Receiving" and include tracking in your email to reception.
Sofie: If it's fragile, add "Fragile" on the label and email tracking so MailRoom can flag it.
MailRoomBot: package_notice: UPS 1 of 1 expected 2024-07-05 10:00, weight 4lb.
Lena: Thanks  sending names + tracking now. See you all at 12:50 :wave:
Reception: Badges will be on the desk. If courier arrives early leave at front desk and we'll move to secure storage.
